image_description: A young girl wearing a patterned hat and green shirt is blowing bubbles in an outdoor urban setting with stone steps. Several translucent soap bubbles are visible floating in the air, exhibiting iridescent colors and reflecting the surroundings. A woman stands in the background on the steps.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The iridescent patterns on the bubbles appear slightly 'painted' or static rather than having the fluid, shifting quality of real thin-film interference. The edges are also somewhat soft, lacking the crisp high-contrast refraction line often seen in macro photography of bubbles.
The background figure shows slight anatomical ambiguity and blending of the hands with the torso/clothing, a common AI generation artifact in out-of-focus human subjects.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'painted' look of the bubble colors. Real bubbles have very specific, sharp interference fringes. AI often smears these colors. Also, check if the refraction of the background through the bubbles is physically accurate (inverted/distorted correctly) or if it just looks like a blurry overlay.
